title: Default index.shard.check_on_startup to false for searchable snapshots

timeline.message:
Mount snapshots with index.shard.check_on_startup to false

Closes #73147
timeline.author: Tanguy Leroux

timeline.body:
Today a searchable snapshot index inherits the `index.shard.check_on_startup` index setting from the snapshot it is mounted from. But this setting can require some expensive processing as documented in #74233, so we decided in #73147 to default the value of this setting to `false` but allow the user to override this in the mount request.

Closes #73147

Note to reviewer: I don't see this as a breaking change neither I think it should deserve a mention in the Mount API as the setting is "expert only", so I did not update documentation. Let me know if you think I should.
We set this explicitly to `false` above (line 170); I think for this to be meaningful we should not set it in the mount request and make sure it's set randomly in the original index.

reply.body:
🤦🏻 

I pushed 2b8edfe5e660e1aeb49f0549464e22468036e1b1 to set a default value in the original index settings and check it is mounted with the `false` default value.

I also added a test to verify that it can be overridden in the mount request.

I also cleaned up other tests to not explicitly set the `false` value.

timeline.body: Thanks Tanguy, I left a couple of comments on the tests.

timeline.author: Tanguy Leroux

timeline.body: I just realised we missed a bit of tidy-up here, with this change we no longer need to set `index.shard.check_on_startup: false` in the `MountSnapshotStep`.

I also noticed that we need to always set at least to `false` in test because the test framework randomly insert this setting too.

I'll open a follow up
I raised #74282 since `testCreateAndRestorePartialSearchableSnapshot` failed on my PR branch and reproducible locally. Also muted the test.
